as_told.title: Lucille Ball hears radio through tooth filling

plain: The actress Lucille Ball is said to have once heard radio music inside her own head after getting a tooth filling, as if her mouth were picking up a broadcast. In a recording of her own account played on the show, Ball says that around World War II, driving near a Los Angeles radio station, she heard music getting "louder and louder and louder," reached to turn off her car radio, found it wasn't on, and "realized it was in my mouth"; she credits Buster Keaton in the telling. Michels retells it twice, citing The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary series about children said to read minds, adding that she was on an overpass, as an example of the body picking up signals the way a radio does.
